title: Complete the current contract batch and receive original planning evidence
instruction: Use the frozen REQ, original registered design and conditional sources. Complete the CONTRACTS index and all applicable FE/BE/SYNC contracts. Fill only answer. Pass and applicability are your professional judgments; original contracts/scenario gates, human decisions and downstream independent review remain required.

conclusion.question: Has your exact contract batch self-review passed?

index_path.question: Where is the actual locked CONTRACTS index?

contract_paths.question: List the complete applicable locked FE/BE/SYNC contract paths.

applicability.question: Set answer.applicability to an object with exactly FE, BE and SYNC. Each family value must be an object with exactly disposition and rationale: disposition is required or not_applicable; rationale is your concrete reason matching the original requirement/design scope. Do not use a string value or a verdict field.
